name: salesforce-case-app
description: Mock Salesforce-style case management web app (login, multi-screen case + timesheet submission, admin approve/reject) used as an automation target.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
